name: cobra-skill
description: One Claude Code skill, published with the evaluation that measured it.

plugins.name: cobra
plugins.description: Check what a measure actually rewards before adopting it. Attach a reward to a proxy and the system optimises the proxy: coverage gates get satisfied by assertion-free tests, latency SLOs by shedding slow requests, and "make the tests pass" by deleting the test. Also covers safeguards whose success is reported rather than verified. Measured against a no-skill baseline: +26.7pp averaged over three signal tasks, 83% trigger recall, 3 false fires across 39 negative runs including five near-miss prompts.
